0022600016.text: In Emirates NBA Cup East Group C play, the Chicago Bulls (1-4, 12th in the East) visit the Boston Celtics (3-1, 2nd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back), who have won three straight and are 3-0 at home. The Bulls enter on a three-game losing streak and are 1-2 on the road, and they trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 134-99 loss in Boston on October 26, having lost the 2025-26 series 1-2. Chicago is missing Dailyn Swain (back soreness) and Nic Claxton (hamstring), while Boston is without Devin Carter (illness).
